intent: Make the actual Home Assistant friendly names for every PID parameter start with the literal PID acronym in all 38 supported languages. Include native per-device tuning numbers, measured-model calibration inputs, fan capacity model selectors/measurements/buttons, room PID numbers and gain selectors. Preserve translated descriptions and exact entity/unique IDs.
note: Correct both generated i18n names and PID parameter has_entity_name behavior; HA device or physical channel prefixes must not precede PID in friendly_name. No native power, control behavior, settings, calibration data, or config entry migration changes.

Move the multi-channel placeholder after PID; avoid duplicate literal PID strings within the same localized display name while preserving locale-specific wording and units.
Mark only per-controller and room PID parameter entities as has_entity_name=False so Home Assistant never inserts the physical device/room name ahead of the PID sorting prefix in friendly_name.

Apply to Kp/Ki/Kd, PID sample/cycle duration, process model inputs, capacity stage/speed/output inputs, PID calibration selectors, explicit Apply buttons, room-level and direct room tuning, and the room PID gain-source selector.
Preserve the original integration domain, entity registry unique IDs, translation keys, channel/device associations, valid ranges, selectable modes, and physical controller behavior.
Retain non-PID names (climate/quiet/physical devices), existing control mode selector, and the existing beta31–41 safety and measured-capacity behavior.

Test real Home Assistant 2026.10 entity has_entity_name behavior and exact original unique IDs, all locales' PID prefixes, generator idempotence and non-PID unchanged names, plus existing Python/Node, HACS/Hassfest and flat archive gates.
